Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values against human single-protein target CHEMBL220 (Acetylcholinesterase). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL220, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
